hooks.command: jq -c '((.tool_input.prompt // "") | gsub("\\s+"; " ") | ascii_downcase) as $p | if ($p | contains("adversarial reviewer") or contains("review a swamp extension before it is published")) then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "ask", permissionDecisionReason: "This starts a review round, which costs a fresh Opus agent. A build has two at most; allow it only if you agreed to this round."}} else empty end'
